description: Overlay that renders PDF annotation highlights and margin markers over the current page. Used internally by TmPdfViewer when annotations are enabled, reusing the shared document comment models.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Current user id used for mention styling.

parameters.name: ShowResolved
parameters.description: Whether resolved threads should be rendered.

parameters.name: DraftAnchor
parameters.description: Current draft anchor for a pending, not-yet-saved annotation.

parameters.name: OnThreadSelected
parameters.description: Callback invoked when a thread marker or highlight is selected.
